questions.q: A shopkeeper marks an item 40% above cost and gives a 20% discount. What is the overall gain?
What comes next in the series? 4, 7, 12, 19, 28, …
questions.why: n² + 3 for n = 1, 2, …. Next: 39. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Priya is facing east. She turns 90 degrees clockwise, then 180 degrees, then 90 degrees anticlockwise. Which direction is she facing now?
questions.why: East, then clockwise to south, then about-turn to north, then anticlockwise to west.

questions.q: The present ages of Kavita and Meera are in the ratio 6 : 3. After 10 years the ratio will be 28 : 19. What is Meera's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 6k and 3k: (6k + 10)/(3k + 10) = 28/19 gives k = 3, so Meera is 9. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 7, 10, 16, 28, 52, ?
questions.why: The differences double each time: 3, 6, 12, 24, then 48. So 52 + 48 = 100.

questions.q: Lata is the son of Deepak. Ajay is the daughter of Deepak. Neha is the husband of Ajay. How is Neha related to Lata?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Brother-in-law. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If 20 April 2019 was a Saturday, what day of the week was 27 May 2019?
questions.why: 37 days later; 37 mod 7 = 2, so count 2 days on from Saturday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 11, 22, 33, 44, 60, 66, 77
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 11, so 60 should be 55. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a group of 90 people, 58 like cricket, 36 like football and 3 like neither. How many like only cricket?
questions.why: Both = 58 + 36 − (90 − 3) = 7; only cricket = 58 − 7 = 51. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 3, 5, 9, 17, 33, …
questions.why: Each term is ×2 − 1. Next: 65. GPSC-style practice item.
